So we need both area and circumference for radius 5. But we only have circumference function that takes diameter. So we can compute circumference by calling circle_calculate_circumference with diameter=10 (since diameter=2*radius). So we can call that function. Then also call circle_calculate_area with radius=5. Then also find circumference for diameter 10: same as above. So we can reuse the same circumference result. So we need to call circle_calculate_circumference twice? We can call once and reuse.
